expressive.wrappingCopy: Wrapping tags change how the text inside them is delivered. When disabled, the wrapper is removed but the inner text is still spoken.

hints.allowRunningJokes: Preserve recurring jokes and shared references from the channel.

followDefense.title: Follow Defense
followDefense.subtitle: Protect your channel from follow floods and hate raids.
followDefense.enabledDescription: Turn this off if you use another protection system or do not want DimaBot to interfere with follow alerts/moderation.
